title: Record Seed Making drive: Fostering Environmental Sustainability
summary: 124 volunteers gathered on 29th August 2024 and successfully created a record-breaking 12k+ seed balls.
description: As part of the #HourToEmpower initiative, 124 volunteers gathered on 29th August 2024 and successfully created a record-breaking 12k+ seed balls. This environment-first effort encouraged reforestation and sustainability while promoting collective action for greener communities.
